1946, November 24
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanas Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
SERAPHIC MASS ASSOCIATION FOR THE SUPPORT OF THE CAPUCHIN FOREIGN MISSIONS
Nov. 24th 1946
DEAR FRIEND OF THE MISSIONS: God bless you Mrs. Ronan - you and yours.
MAY THE LORD GIVE YOU HIS PEACE!
I WISH TO THANK YOU SINCERELY FOR YOUR KIND AND GENEROUS AIMS TO THE CAPUCHIN FOREIGN MISSIONS. I AM SURE THAT THE PRAYERS CF THE MISSIONA IES WILL ASCEND TO THE THRONE OF GOD FOR YOUR WELFARE.
UNDER SEPARATE COVER I AM MAILING YOU THE CER- TIFICATES OF ENROLLMENT, WHICH I TRUST YOU WILL LIKE,
GRATEFULLY YOURS IN CHRIST, Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
P.S. With that stiff knee of yours, you ought to see a good chiropractor or ostiopath.
Note : Above is copy of a printed correspondence form-card, with rubber stamp signature, to wit: "Fr. Solanus, O.3.M. Cap." The printed-form portion is indicated ir solid caps. Added in Fr. Solanus' hand is, "God bless you 11 together with the date and the "P.S. . Also added in his hand is a note on the reverse side of the card, as indicated on Page Two hereof.
